title: Power And Thermal
plain_reading: Power and heat must be measured during the same run before they support a strong claim.
what_this_supports: When present, it can support measured energy and temperature claims for the exact tested setup.
what_this_does_not_prove: A power estimate or separate lab run does not prove the reviewed package.
next_actions: Add power and thermal import contracts.
